v2.scope: Original R4 real-admin DOM/session/relationship characterization, unchanged exact v2 runtime template. No H19 closure claim. Optional React/Vue probes list the native lifecycle and population titles below for each CSRF variant; execution remains separate from a source declaration.
expectedTitles: the packed plugin supplies the preview URL and Payload 2 schema is observed
unsaved title reaches the preview and leaves the database unchanged
markup typed into a scalar remains text
a relationship chosen in the admin reaches the populated preview field
the real session gates runtime injection and the initial global read
Payload 2 authorizes cookie-only without triggering the new Origin retry
an explicitly listed origin is accepted and an unlisted origin is refused

nativeLifecycleTitles.freshOwner: same-realm fresh owner refuses retired work before distinct provider recovery
nativeLifecycleTitles.documentNavigation: real admin navigation owns saved SSR data and first-schema population
nativeLifecycleTitles.childReload: child reload refuses schema-less updates before distinct provider recovery

nativeGuardsTitles.lateResponse: a late successful response of a replaced owner leaves the record and the tree as they were
nativeGuardsTitles.foreignSenders: a window of the admin origin that is not the admin and a foreign origin are refused while the admin's own message is taken
nativeGuardsTitles.originAlone: with every window allowed, the origin check alone refuses an origin nobody listed
nativeGuardsTitles.noOriginLock: a second listed origin is taken after the first and an origin that is not listed is still refused
nativeGuardsTitles.receiverSwitch: naming another frame as the receiver of a running session restores the seed, retires the old window and acts once on the new one
nativeGuardsTitles.receiverSwitchHeld: an answer to a read held at the receiver switch cannot change the new session
nativeGuardsTitles.authExpiry: a sign-out in the same context makes the next update unavailable with the HTTP status and a sign-in brings it back

nativePopulationTitles.hydration: native SSR hydrates and the authentic first v2 schema message settles live
nativePopulationTitles.unsavedTitle: a real unsaved title reaches the native tree while the saved document stays unchanged
nativePopulationTitles.sessionSchema: a subsequent schema-free subtitle update uses the session schema
nativePopulationTitles.markupAsText: scalar markup stays text in the native renderer
nativePopulationTitles.populatedRelationship: the real relationship id is populated by credentialed cross-origin collection GET
nativePopulationTitles.nextRelationship: relationship changes after the first schema populate the next id rather than keep the old author
nativePopulationTitles.editorSession: only the real editor session receives the native preview and its initial saved read
nativePopulationTitles.csrfVariant: the real v2 session keeps cookie-only and explicit Origin behavior in its pinned CSRF variant

v3.scope: Fresh isolated regular dependency consumer, actual native SSR/hydration/remount/document/target and credential-free actual wire metadata. v4 remains a pre-release characterization with profile review required, never transferred to v3 support.

v4.scope: Fresh isolated regular dependency consumer, actual native SSR/hydration/remount/document/target and credential-free actual wire metadata. v4 remains a pre-release characterization with profile review required, never transferred to v3 support.

separation: Every prepare uses a new output, exact package manifest, own vendor archive, own lock and new DB. v2 never uses the v3 demo or v4 packages. v4 never contributes Node20 support. No latest/range dependency or peer-bypass option.
archiveSelection: Explicit absolute --tarball and SHA256; no default or repack.
runtimeProbeRequires: Regular own app/node_modules and byte-exact installed candidate inventory
Exact family/Next/React versions and required peer ranges
Explicit resource release; no active mutation
Fresh own DB and no earlier native probe output
v4ProfileDecision: Observed credential-free wire shape only. The 4.0.0-beta.4 corpus in tests/fixtures/wire-corpus is the captured evidence for this version; a production v4 profile still requires review under ADR0010.
integrationTarget: examples/payload-version-lanes; a portable developmental fixture with no dependency trees, reports, databases, private maintainer docs or retained archives in its source tree.
